name: hip lateral rotation (external rotation)
description: Rotating the thigh outward at the hip, working the deep hip rotators and glutes.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
